blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Conversational AI systems trained on large-scale web corpora inevitably encode the cultural values and interactional norms embedded in their training data, yet our understanding of how deployed LLMs reflect or reinforce culture-specific social expectations remains limited. This study examined how supportive versus challenging chatbot interaction styles shape user experience and continuance intention, and whether people-pleasing tendency (PPT) moderates these effects across cultures. Taiwanese (N = 49) and Korean (N = 52) participants completed a collaborative tourism-planning task. Results showed that: (1) supportive chatbots consistently led to higher continuance intention, satisfaction, and trust; (2) PPT did not moderate these effects; and (3) cultural variation emerged only in perceived threat, where higher PPT was associated with greater baseline threat in the Taiwanese but not the Korean sample. These findings reveal how a general-purpose LLM style may differentially activate culturally situated social scripts, raising implications for culturally inclusive conversational AI design.
blocks.zh: 在大规模网络公司培训的有争议人工智能系统不可避免地将文化价值和互动规范编码在培训数据中,然而,我们对所部署的有限责任公司如何反映或加强文化特有的社会期望的理解仍然有限。 该研究研究了支持性与挑战性聊天器互动风格如何塑造用户体验和持续意图,以及人们的取悦倾向是否缓解了不同文化间的这些影响。 台湾人(N=49人)和朝鲜人(N=52人)的参与者完成了合作旅游规划任务. 结果显示:(1) 支持性聊天机器人一直导致更高的持续意图、满意程度和信任程度;(2) 预防酷刑没有减轻这些影响;和(3) 文化差异只出现在感知到的威胁中,在台湾人中,预防酷刑的较高水平与更高的基线威胁有关,而在韩国样本中则并非如此。 这些调查结果揭示了通用LLM风格如何不同地激活位于文化背景的社会脚本,从而对文化包容性的对话AI设计产生了影响。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Chatbots have rapidly evolved from simple, script-based tools into sophisticated conversational systems used in a wide range of collaborative and decision-support contexts ( Abdul-Kader and Woods, 2015 ) . Powered by deep learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP), chatbots are increasingly experienced as interactive partners ( Guzman and Lewis, 2020 ) . By enabling communication through natural language, AI-based chatbots reduce interaction barriers and allow users to express intentions directly through conversation ( George and George, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: Chatbots从简单,基于脚本的工具迅速发展成为在广泛的协作和决策支持背景下使用的精密的对话系统(Abdul-Kader and Woods, 2015). 在深层学习和自然语言处理(NLP)的推动下,聊天人作为互动伙伴(Guzman和Lewis,2020年)的体验越来越多. 通过通过自然语言实现交流,基于AI的聊天员减少了互动障碍,并允许用户通过对话直接表达意向(George and George, 2023) .

blocks.en: Recent NLP research shows that language models trained on web-scale corpora absorb the dominant cultural values encoded in those corpora ( Cao et al., 2023 ; Dewitt Prat et al., 2024 ; Tao et al., 2024 ; Rao et al., 2025 ; Pang et al., 2025 ; Shankar et al., 2026 ) . When such systems are deployed across culturally diverse user populations, the interaction styles that feel natural to one cultural group may feel intrusive or socially inappropriate to another. This raises a critical question for the NLP community: how does NLP technology reflect and/or reinforce cultural values and stereotypes in situated human-AI interaction?
blocks.zh: 最近的NLP研究表明,接受过网络尺度公司培训的语言模型吸收了这些公司编码的主要文化价值(Cao等人,2023年;Dewitt Prat等人,2024年;Tao等人,2024年;Rao等人,2025年;Pang等人,2025年;Shankar等人,2026年)。 当这种系统在文化不同的用户群体中部署时,一种文化群体认为自然的互动方式可能感到侵入性或社会上对另一个文化群体不合适。 这给NLP社区提出了一个关键问题:NLP技术如何在人与AI互动中反映和/或强化文化价值观和定型观念?

blocks.en: From a socio-cultural perspective, interaction involves not only information exchange but also the fulfillment of users’ affective needs ( Burnett, 2000 ) . According to the Computers Are Social Actors (CASA) paradigm ( Nass et al., 1994 ) , humans naturally apply social heuristics to technologies. If NLP-driven chatbots communicate in ways that resonate with one cultural group’s social norms, they may inadvertently reinforce those norms while creating friction for users from other cultural backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 从社会文化角度看,互动不仅涉及信息交流,而且还涉及满足用户的情感需求(Burnett,2000年)。 根据计算机是社会演员(CASA)范式(Nass等人,1994年),人类自然将社会heuristic应用到技术中. 如果NLP驱动的聊天人以与一个文化团体的社会规范产生共鸣的方式进行交流,他们可能会无意中强化这些规范,同时为来自其他文化背景的用户制造摩擦.

blocks.en: Our study focuses on Taiwanese and Korean participants, cultures and languages underrepresented in mainstream LLM training data. The following research questions guide the analysis:
blocks.zh: 我们的研究重点是台湾和韩国的参与者、主流LLM培训数据中代表性不足的文化和语言。 以下研究问题为分析提供了指导:

blocks.en: RQ1: Does people-pleasing tendency (PPT) moderate the effect of chatbot interaction style on users’ intention to collaborate? RQ2: Does PPT moderate the relationship between chatbot style and users’ collaboration experience? RQ3: How cross-cultural differences in the perception of chatbot interaction styles reflect different interactional expectations across cultural contexts?
blocks.zh: RQ1:人情味的倾向(PPT)是否缓和了聊天机交互风格对用户合作意图的影响?. RQ2:PPT是否缓和了聊天机风格与用户合作体验之间的关系? RQ3:对聊天机器人互动风格感知的跨文化差异如何反映不同文化背景的不同互动期望?.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 People-Pleasing Tendencies
blocks.zh: 2.1 人民议会

blocks.en: People-pleasing tendencies refer to a behavioral orientation characterized by habitual efforts to prioritize others’ needs to facilitate interpersonal harmony ( George and George, 2023 ; Kückelhaus and Blickle, 2025 ) . While social approval serves a functional role, these tendencies become maladaptive when excessive ( Gilbert and Irons, 2005 ; Ehman, 2021 ) . They are associated with compliance, conflict avoidance, and deference, particularly among individuals high in agreeableness ( Flett, 2002 ; Van Scotter and Van Scotter, 2021 ) . Research within the CASA paradigm suggests that users apply social norms and interpersonal expectations to interactive systems. Building on this, people-pleasing tendencies may systematically shape how individuals respond to social cues in human-AI interaction contexts.
blocks.zh: 人与人之间的和谐(George and George, 2023; Kückelhaus and Blickle, 2025)。 虽然社会认可起到功能作用,但这些倾向在过度时变得不适应(Gilbert and Irons,2005;Ehman,2021). 它们与遵纪守法、避免冲突和尊重有关,特别是在个人之间(Flett,2002;Van Scotter和Van Scotter,2021)。 CASA范式内的研究表明,用户将社会规范和人际期望应用于交互系统. 在此基础上,人们的悲观倾向可能系统地决定个人如何在人类-AI互动背景下回应社会提示。

blocks.en: 2.2 Cultural Encoding in NLP-Driven Chatbot Communication
blocks.zh: 2.2 NLP-Driven Chatbot通信中的文化编码

blocks.en:
Prior work has demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) encode cultural knowledge, including social hierarchies, politeness strategies, and collectivist versus individualist communicative norms ( Hershcovich et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Masoud et al., 2025 ) . Language style matching (LSM), the degree to which interlocutors mirror each other’s function-word usage and emotional register, varies systematically across cultures Gonzales et al. (2010) , and NLP models trained predominantly on English-language data may encode Western interactional defaults that do not transfer smoothly to East Asian social contexts.
In social support contexts, both higher LSM and positive emotion words influence emotional improvement ( Bowen et al., 2017 ; Cannava and Bodie, 2017 ) . In challenging interactions, however, higher LSM has been linked to lower perceived responsiveness ( Bowen et al., 2017 ) . These dynamics suggest that an NLP system optimized for one cultural register may reflect that register’s values while inadvertently marginalizing users whose communicative expectations differ.
blocks.zh:
先前的研究表明,大型语言模型编纂了文化知识,包括社会等级、礼貌策略和集体主义与个人主义交流规范(Hershcovich等人,2022年;Cao等人,2023年;Masoud等人,2025年)。 语言风格匹配(LSM)是对话者相互反映功能词的使用和情感记录的程度,在不同文化间,Gonzales等人(2010年)有系统差异,主要接受英语数据培训的NLP模型可能编码西方互动默认,不会顺利地转移到东亚社会环境.
在社会支持背景下,更高的LSM和积极的情感词都会影响情感改善(Bowen等人,2017年;Cannava和Bodie,2017年). 然而,在具有挑战性的互动中,较高的LSM与较低的反应感有关(Bowen等人,2017年)。 这些动态表明,为一种文化登记册优化的NLP系统可能反映该登记册的价值,同时无意中将那些沟通期望不同的用户边缘化。

blocks.en: 2.3 User Experience in Human-AI Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.3 人类-AI相互作用的用户经验

blocks.en:
User experience (UX) encompasses users’ subjective perceptions, affective responses, and experiential evaluations beyond mere functional usability ( Hassenzahl and Tractinsky, 2006 ) . In human-AI interaction, UX extends to perceptions of trust, comfort, and the quality of interaction with intelligent agents. As AI systems increasingly communicate through natural language, users interpret AI behavior in ways resembling social interaction ( Følstad and Brandtzæg, 2017 ) .
Critically, these perceptions are not culturally neutral. The same chatbot utterance may be decoded through different cultural lenses: a direct question may be experienced as autonomy-supporting in an individualist context and face-threatening in a collectivist one. When NLP systems are designed without this cultural sensitivity, they risk reinforcing the values of the dominant training culture while undermining trust and satisfaction for users from other backgrounds.
blocks.zh:
用户体验(UX)包括用户的主观感知,感知性反应,以及超出单纯功能性可用性的体验性评价(Hassenzahl和Tractinsky,2006年). 在人与AI的相互作用中,UX延伸到信任感,舒适感,以及与智能剂相互作用的质量. 随着AI系统越来越多地通过自然语言进行交流,用户以类似社会互动的方式解释AI的行为(Følstad和Brandtzæg,2017年).
关键的是,这些观念在文化上并不是中立的。 同一聊天机器人的语句可以通过不同的文化透镜解码:一个直接的问题可能在个人主义背景下作为自主支持而出现,在集体主义背景下则会面临威胁。 当NLP系统的设计没有这种文化敏感性时,它们有可能强化主导培训文化的价值观,同时损害来自其他背景的用户的信任和满意度.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Chatbot Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 聊天机器人设计

blocks.en: We operationalized supportive and challenging chatbot interaction styles through prompt design along four dimensions: linguistic style, value orientation, interaction strategy, and tone ( Gonzales et al., 2010 ; Ireland and Pennebaker, 2010 ; Rains, 2016 ; Bowen et al., 2017 ; Cannava and Bodie, 2017 ; Georgescu and Bodislav, 2025 ) (see Figure 1 ). The supportive chatbot employed positive emotion words, stylistic mirroring, and empathic cues, whereas the challenging chatbot minimized affective language and emphasized autonomy and critical reflection. These styles were intentionally designed to map onto contrasting cultural interactional scripts: the supportive style aligns with high-context, harmony-oriented norms common in Collectivist cultures, while the challenging style reflects low-context, directness-oriented norms more commonly associated with individualist cultural settings. GPT-4.1 was selected with temperature fixed at 0.2. 1 1 1 The experimental code, data, and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/yjchen0722/OSFA .
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个层面的快速设计,将支持性和挑战性聊天机器人互动风格付诸实施:语言风格、价值导向、互动战略和语气(Gonzales等人,2010年;爱尔兰和Pennebaker,2010年;Rains,2016年;Bowen等人,2017年;Cannava和Bodie,2017年;Georgescu和Bodislav,2025年)(见图1)。 支持的聊天员使用正面的情感语句、风格的反射和同情的提示,而具有挑战性的聊天员则将情感语言降到最低,强调自主性和批判性的反思。 这些风格被有意设计为将对比性的文化交互脚本映射:支持性风格与高背景,和谐导向的规范相配合,在集合主义文化中常见,而挑战性风格则反映了低背景,直接性导向的规范更通常与个人主义文化环境相关. GPT-4.1被选用,温度固定在0.2. 1 1 实验代码、数据和补充材料见https://github.com/yjchen0722/OSFA。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.2 Participants
blocks.zh: 3.2 与会者

blocks.en: Participants were recruited from the MZ generation (Millennials 1981–1996; Generation Z 1997–2012) ( Dimock, 2019 ) , excluding minors. The final sample consisted of 101 participants from Taiwan (n = 49) and South Korea (n = 52). The study procedure is illustrated in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 参与者来自MZ一代(1981-1996年千年;1997-2012年一代Z)(Dimock,2019年),不包括未成年人. 最终样本包括101名来自台湾(n=49)和韩国(n=52)的参与者. 研究程序见图2。

blocks.en: 3.3 Procedure
blocks.zh: 3.3 程序

blocks.en: The study comprised three phases: pre-interaction assessment, collaborative human-chatbot interaction, and post-interaction assessment. Participants first provided informed consent and completed the People Pleasing Scale (PPS). In the interaction phase, participants engaged in a collaborative tourism-planning task over three iterative stages. Following the interaction, participants completed validated scales and open-ended questions.
blocks.zh: 该研究包括三个阶段:互动前评估、人与机器人协作互动和互动后评估。 与会者首先提供了知情同意,并完成了民众欢乐比额表。 在互动阶段,与会者在三个迭代阶段开展了旅游规划合作任务。 在互动之后,与会者完成了经过验证的尺度和开放式问题。

blocks.en: 3.4 Measures
blocks.zh: 3.4 措施

blocks.en: People-Pleasing Tendency was assessed using the 10-item PPS ( Blötner, 2025 ) on a 5-point Likert scale. Post-interaction measures included: Perceived Threat (PT, 6 items, 7-point; adapted from Yanan, 2023 ); Satisfaction (SA, 3 items, 5-point; John P. Chin and Norman, 1988 ); Trust (TR, 8 items, 7-point; adapted from Dolinek and Wintersberger, 2022 ; Scharowski et al., 2024 ); and Continuance Intention (CI, 3 items, 7-point; Bhattacherjee, 2001 ). All instruments were administered in Taiwan Mandarin or Korean, according to the participant’s native language. To ensure cross-cultural validity, all scales underwent a careful translation and back-translation procedure, followed by native speaker review to confirm conceptual equivalence. Cronbach’s α \alpha exceeded .70 for all scales in both samples.
blocks.zh: 利用10项PPS(Blötner, 2025年), 互动措施包括: 预测的威胁(PT,6项,7点;改编自2023年延安);满足(SA,3项,5点;John P. Chin和Norman,1988年);信托(TR,8项,7点;改编自2022年的Dolink和Wintersberger;Scharowski等人,2024年);以及持续意图(CI,3项,7点;Bhattacherjee,2001年)。 根据参与者的母语,所有仪器都使用台湾普通话或朝鲜语。 为了确保跨文化的有效性,所有比例尺都经过了仔细的翻译和反翻译程序,然后是本地人审查,以确认概念上的等同性。 Cronbach的α-α在两种样本中的所有鳞片都超过了.

blocks.en: 4.1 RQ1: Continuance Intention
blocks.zh: 4.1 RQ1: 持续意图

blocks.en: Participants assigned to the supportive chatbot reported higher continuance intention than those in the challenging condition in both the Taiwanese ( β = 2.48 , p < .001 \beta=2.48,p<.001 ) and Korean ( β = 2.17 , p < .001 \beta=2.17,p<.001 ) samples. PPT was not significant as a main effect and did not moderate the effect of chatbot style on CI in either sample ( R 2 R^{2} TW = .53; R 2 R^{2} KR = .35)(see Table 1 and Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 分配到支助聊天台的与会者在台湾样本(β = 2.48,p < .001\β=2.48,p <.001)和朝鲜样本(β = 2.17,p <.001\β=2.17,p < 001)中报告的延续意向高于面临挑战的台湾样本。 PPT作为一种主要效果并不显著,在两个样本中都没有缓和聊天员风格对CI的影响(R 2 R^{2}TW =.53;R 2 R^{2}KR = 35)(见表1和图3)。

blocks.en: 4.2 RQ2: User Experience
blocks.zh: 4.2 RQ2:用户经验

blocks.en: The supportive chatbot produced significantly higher satisfaction (SA) and trust (TR) in both samples. For perceived threat (PT), the supportive style significantly reduced threat in Taiwan ( β = − 2.65 , < .001 \beta=-2.65,<.001 ) but not in Korea. PPT showed a significant positive main effect on PT only in Taiwan ( β = 0.08 , p < .05 \beta=0.08,p<.05 ), with no effect in Korea. PPT did not moderate the effects of chatbot style on any UX outcome in either sample(see Table 1 and Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 支持性聊天机器人在两个样本中都产生了显著更高的满意度(SA)和信任度(TR). 对于感知到的威胁(PT),支持式在台湾显著降低威胁(β = - 2.65, < 001\beta = -2.65, < 001),但韩国没有. PPT只在台湾对PT表现出显著的正面主要影响(β=0.08,p < .05\beta=0.08,p <.05),在韩国没有效果. PPT没有在任何一个样本中缓和聊天机器人风格对任何UX结果的影响(见表1和图3)。

blocks.en: 4.3 RQ3: Cultural Framing of NLP Interaction Styles
blocks.zh: 4.3 RQ3: NLP 互动样式的文化结构

blocks.en:
The divergent threat pattern, present in Taiwan but absent in Korea, indicates that the two cultural groups activated different social scripts when processing the same NLP-generated chatbot output. In Taiwan, the challenging style’s low-context, directness-oriented cues were decoded through a harmony-sensitive lens, elevating perceived threat particularly among high-PPT users. In contrast, Korean participants may have interpreted the same outputs as more task-focused rather than socially evaluative.
These findings suggest that chatbot interaction styles may carry different social meanings across cultural contexts. Rather than functioning as culturally neutral communication tools, NLP-generated conversational styles may interact with users’ culturally situated expectations regarding harmony, directness, and interpersonal sensitivity.
blocks.zh:
不同的威胁模式存在于台湾,但在韩国却不存在,这表明两个文化群体在处理相同的NLP生成的聊天机器人输出时激活了不同的社会脚本. 在台湾,挑战性风格的低调、面向直觉的提示通过对和谐敏感的镜头解码,提高了人们特别是高PPT用户的认知威胁。 相比之下,韩国参与者可能将同样的产出解释为更注重任务而不是社会评价。
这些研究结果表明,聊天机器人的互动风格可能具有不同的文化背景的社会意义。 NLP产生的对话风格与其作为文化中立的交流工具发挥作用,不如与用户在文化上对和谐、直接性和人际敏感性的期望互动。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Robust Effects of Chatbot Style Across Cultures
blocks.zh: 5.1 整个文化的聊天机器人风格的强大影响

blocks.en:
Across both samples, chatbot interaction style emerged as a key driver of continuance intention and collaborative experience. This is consistent with the CASA paradigm ( Nass et al., 1994 ) and social presence theory ( Short et al., 1976 ) , suggesting that warm and affiliative conversational cues enhance perceived social presence, elevating satisfaction and trust.
From an NLP perspective, the supportive prompt incorporated linguistic features such as positive emotion words, stylistic mirroring, and emojis, which may function as recognizable social signals across cultural contexts. These findings align with prior NLP research suggesting that certain politeness-related interaction cues possess broad interactional salience across cultures.
blocks.zh:
在这两个样本中,聊天机器人互动风格成为持续意图和合作经验的关键驱动力。 这符合CASA范式(Nass等人,1994年)和社会存在理论(Short等人,1976年),认为温暖和亲和的对话提示可以增强人们的认知社会存在,提高满意度和信任度。
从NLP的观点来看,支持的即时融入了各种语言特征,如正面的情感词,风格的反射,以及emojis等,它们可能起到不同文化背景的可识别的社会信号的作用. 这些结论与NLP之前的研究一致,认为某些与礼貌有关的互动提示具有不同文化间广泛的互动优势。

blocks.en: 5.2 Primacy of Interaction Style over Personality
blocks.zh: 5.2 互动风格优先于个人

blocks.en: PPT did not moderate the effects of chatbot style on any dependent variable, indicating that the benefits of supportive interaction are robust across interpersonal orientations. Although PPT did not function as a moderator, it exhibited a culture-specific main effect on perceived threat in Taiwan. This finding suggests that PPT may influence users’ baseline emotional sensitivity during human-AI interaction rather than amplifying or weakening the impact of specific chatbot styles. In other words, interpersonal tendencies may shape how emotionally sensitive users are to interaction contexts, while supportive conversational cues appear broadly effective regardless of personality differences.
blocks.zh: PPT并没有缓和聊天器风格对任何依赖变量的影响,表明支持性互动的好处在人际取向上都很强. 虽然PPT没有发挥主持人的作用,但它对台湾的感知威胁表现出了文化上特有的主要影响. 这一调查结果表明,PPT可能会在人与AI互动期间影响用户的基线情感敏感性,而不是扩大或削弱特定聊天员风格的影响. 换句话说,人际倾向可能会决定用户对互动环境的情感敏感性如何,而无论个性差异如何,支持性的对话提示显得广泛有效.

blocks.en: 5.3 How NLP Systems Reflect and Reinforce Cultural Values
blocks.zh: 5.3 NLP系统如何反映和加强文化价值

blocks.en:
The divergent threat patterns across Taiwan and Korea constitute direct evidence that NLP-generated conversational styles can reflect and reinforce culture-specific interactional values. The challenging chatbot style produced elevated threat perceptions in Taiwan but not Korea, despite both samples drawing from broadly collectivist cultural backgrounds.
Taiwan’s threat pattern is consistent with psychosocial equilibrium theory ( Han, 2016 ) : when a peer-like agent delivers challenging feedback, it disrupts relational harmony norms salient in Taiwanese social contexts, a dynamic that LLMs trained on mainstream corpora would be unlikely to anticipate. Korea’s comparative insensitivity aligns with research showing that Koreans engage face-threat concerns most acutely in in-group privacy violations rather than task-oriented exchanges ( Cho and Sillars, 2015 ) . These findings suggest that even a broadly positive interaction style may carry different communicative expectations across cultural scripts.
blocks.zh:
台湾和韩国各地不同的威胁模式直接证明NLP产生的对话风格能够反映和加强文化特有的互动价值。 尽管这两个样本都来自广泛的集体文化背景,
台湾的威胁模式符合社会心理平衡理论(Han,2016年):当类似同伴的代理人提供具有挑战性的反馈时,它会破坏台湾社会环境中突出的关系和谐规范,而这种动态是主流公司(LLM)所训练的。 韩国的相对麻木不仁与研究一致, 这些调查结果表明,即使是一种广泛的积极互动风格,也可能在各种文化文字中带来不同的沟通期望。

blocks.en: 5.4 Design Implications for Culturally Inclusive NLP
blocks.zh: 5.4 设计对文化包容性NLP的影响

blocks.en:
First, supportive interaction styles may serve as an effective default design strategy for conversational AI systems. For LLM developers, this means prioritizing training data and prompt engineering that incorporate affiliative cues, showing the broadest cross-cultural applicability.
Second, LLM-based systems that draw on training corpora dominated by directness-oriented text should be audited for the potential cross-cultural threat their default communicative style may carry.
Third, LLM-based systems should incorporate mechanisms to detect culturally salient signals, such as language choice, honorific use, or hedging patterns, to dynamically adjust feedback intensity, rather than relying on static personality-based customization.
blocks.zh:
首先,支持性交互风格可以作为对话AI系统的有效默认设计策略. 对 LLM 开发者来说,这意味着优先考虑培训数据和包含附属提示的快速工程,显示最广泛的跨文化适用性.
第二,应审计以直接面向性的文本为主的基于LLM的系统,以了解其默认的沟通方式可能带来的潜在的跨文化威胁。
三,基于LLM的系统应当包含检测文化显著信号的机制,如语言选择,荣誉使用,或套期模式,以动态调整反馈强度,而不是依赖静态的基于个性定制.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study investigated how people-pleasing tendencies and chatbot interaction styles shape user collaboration in Taiwan and Korea. Framed as an inquiry into how large language models reflect and reinforce cultural values, our findings tell a more complex story than expected. Supportive chatbots consistently elicited higher continuance intentions, satisfaction, and trust across both cultures, suggesting that certain affiliative NLP features have broad cross-cultural salience. However, the differential threat patterns, elevated in Taiwan but absent in Korea in response to the same challenging NLP outputs, demonstrate that conversational AI systems do not merely transmit information neutrally; they carry culturally specific interactional scripts that resonate differently depending on users’ cultural framing of the interaction. PPT did not moderate the effects of chatbot style but showed a culture-specific main effect on perceived threat in Taiwan, indicating that interpersonal traits influence baseline emotional sensitivity rather than responsiveness to style variations. From an NLP standpoint, the results call for greater investment in culturally diverse training corpora, culture-sensitive evaluation benchmarks, and adaptive conversational AI capable of recognizing and responding to the social scripts of diverse user communities, steps necessary to prevent large language models from reinforcing the interactional values of dominant training cultures at the expense of others.
blocks.zh: 这项研究调查了台灣和韓國民众取悦的倾向和聊天机器人互动风格如何塑造用户协作. 我们的调查结论以调查大型语言模型如何反映和加强文化价值为框架,它讲述了一个比预期更为复杂的故事。 支持性聊天器不断在两种文化中引起更高的持续意图、满意度和信任,表明某些附属的NLP特征具有广泛的跨文化优势。 然而,不同的威胁模式在台湾有所提升,但在韩国却因同样的挑战性NLP产出而不存在,这表明对话的AI系统并不仅仅是中性地传递信息;它们带有文化上特有的互动脚本,视用户对互动的文化框架而产生不同的共鸣. PPT并没有缓和聊天机器人风格的影响,而是对台湾的感知威胁表现出文化特有的主要影响,表明人际特质会影响基线情感敏感性,而不是对风格变化的反应. 从NLP的观点来看,结果要求加大对多种文化培训的投资,对文化敏感的评价基准,以及能够识别和应对不同用户社区社会文字的适应性对话AI, 防止大型语言模式以牺牲他人为代价强化主流培训文化的互动价值的必要步骤。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Although GPT-4.1 generally adhered to the intended styles, some users deviated by requesting jokes or unrelated content. In addition, GPT-4.1 was trained predominantly on English-language data, raising the possibility that its Mandarin- and Korean-language outputs may carry residual Western communicative defaults that constitute a form of cultural bias independent of our prompt manipulation. Linguistic comparison of chatbot outputs across languages would help clarify this confound. Future work should employ NLP tools such as sentiment lexicons calibrated to each target culture, politeness theory-based annotation, and cross-cultural LSM analysis to operationalize cultural encoding at the utterance level.
blocks.zh: 虽然GPT-4.1一般都坚持预定的风格,但有些用户因要求笑话或不相关的内容而偏离. 此外,GPT-4.1主要接受英语数据培训,因此其普通话和韩语产出可能带有遗留的西方通信默认,构成一种独立于我们迅速操纵的文化偏见。 对各语文的聊天员产出进行语言上的比较,将有助于澄清这种困惑。 今后的工作应利用NLP工具,如根据每个目标文化校准的情感词汇、基于礼貌性理论的注释以及跨文化的LSM分析,以便在语音层面实施文化编码。

blocks.en: A further limitation is that the present study relied primarily on quantitative measures. Although initial evidence from open-ended questions suggests a cultural divide (e.g., Taiwan Mandarin users frequently personified the AI as "he", whereas Korean users referred to it as "chatbot"), these observations require more systematic and structured analysis to be fully validated. As a result, the cultural interpretations proposed in RQ3 remain inferential rather than directly validated through participants’ own explanations. Future research should incorporate qualitative approaches to better understand how users from different cultural backgrounds interpret supportive and challenging chatbot behaviors.
blocks.zh: 另一个限制是,本研究报告主要依靠定量措施。 虽然来自开放式问题的初步证据表明存在文化鸿沟(例如台湾普通话用户经常将AI化为"他",而韩国用户则称其为"chatbot"),但这些观察需要更系统,更有条理的分析才能充分验证. 因此,RQ3中提议的文化解释仍然是不言自明的,而不是通过参与者自己的解释直接加以验证。 未来的研究应当纳入定性方法,以更好地理解来自不同文化背景的用户如何解释支持性的和具有挑战性的聊天员行为。

blocks.en: In addition, the cultural scope of this study was limited to Taiwan and Korea. Although these contexts provide meaningful comparison within East Asian cultures, the findings cannot be generalized to broader cultural populations. Future studies should examine more culturally diverse user groups to better understand how NLP-driven interaction styles are perceived across different linguistic and cultural settings.
blocks.zh: 此外,本研究的文化范围仅限于台湾和韩国. 虽然这些背景在东亚文化中提供了有意义的比较,但研究结果不能泛指更广泛的文化人口。 今后的研究应审查文化上更多样化的用户群体,以更好地理解不同语言和文化环境中如何看待NLP驱动的互动风格。

blocks.en: Finally, this study used a low-stakes tourism-planning task. User responses may differ in high-stakes domains such as medical or financial support. Expanding the analysis to broader task contexts, additional personality dimensions, and more culturally diverse language communities would refine our understanding of how NLP systems reflect and reinforce cultural values.
blocks.zh: 最后,这项研究采用了低价旅游规划任务。 用户在医疗或财政支助等高风险领域的反应可能有所不同。 将分析扩大到更广泛的任务背景、更多的个性层面以及文化上更多样化的语言社区,将改进我们对NLP系统如何反映和加强文化价值的理解。

blocks.en: The post-interaction questionnaire consisted of four quantitative scales and two open-ended qualitative questions. Perceived Threat (PT) Items were measured on a 7-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (Fully Disagree) to 7 (Fully Agree). Satisfaction (SA) Items were measured on a 5-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (Strongly Disagree) to 5 (Strongly Agree). Trust in Context-specific (TR) Items were measured on a 7-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (Fully Disagree) to 7 (Fully Agree). Continuance Intention (CI) Items were measured on a 7-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (Strongly Disagree) to 7 (Strongly Agree). In addition, two open-ended qualitative questions were included to capture participants’ subjective reflections on their interaction with the chatbot.
blocks.zh: 互动后调查表包括四个数量尺度和两个开放式质量问题。 估计的威胁物品按7点的相似度从1(完全不同意)到7(完全同意)不等。 满意程度(SA)项目按5点的相似度衡量,从1(强烈不同意)到5(强烈同意)。 对特定背景(TR)项目的信任按从1(完全不同意)到7(完全同意)的7点相似度衡量。 连续意向(CI)项目按从1(强烈不同意)到7(强烈同意)的7点相似度衡量。 此外,还列入了两个开放式的定性问题,以了解与会者对与聊天员互动的主观看法。
